MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.
   B. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.

4. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.

5. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

6. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

   C. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.

9. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.

10. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)

11. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.
   C. Damage equipment used for Transposition.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Classical Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Context Page 15 of 59 1 STRAND 1.0: FOUNDATION and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Red, blue, and yellow

2. D — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. B — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — The speed of the music

8. C — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs 3.2 Classical Music 3.3 Music and Dance in Socio-Cultural Cont; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
